rule: AGENTS 'Unused old images: delete now'. A file is listed only if it is (1) not the source of an image id used by Config.UIArt or MaterialService, (2) not a Firefly approval dated 2026-10-05 or later, (3) not a 3D model / Tripo record, (4) not already deleted per docs/art/art_cleanup_2026-10-06*.json. Active in-game images (keys with an id) stay until their Firefly replacement is in Studio.
method: scripted inventory of art/ (art/models, art/fonts, art/prompts skipped) + three independent verifier passes (live references in src/tools, approvals and 3D records, missed files). No verifier found a listed file that must stay; additions merged here.
delete_how: tracked files: git rm -- <path> by explicit path (never -A); untracked logs/sidecars: plain delete; then mark their art/ui/asset_ids.json entries 'deleted 2026-10-06 (was …)'.

actions.orphan_log: delete now (untracked, gitignored: plain delete; image already gone)
actions.other: delete now unless the lead objects (stale test sidecars / rejected review sheet)
actions.empty_id_key: lead decides: Config Id is "" since 63b95d9 so the screen never shows them; Config.UIArt.CardLayout numbers were measured from the card PNGs
actions.id_but_unreferenced: lead decides: has an id but no live reader (IconLock; FactionTitleFreshTyped; FactionE *E fallback sprites behind FactionE.Parts)
